title: Rooftop Screamers unleash a driven song of liberation with “My Sanity” (feat. Randy McStine)
htmlContent: Rooftop Screamers capture the powerful feeling of a moment when everything becomes clear in their exciting new single, “My Sanity,” featuring the incredible voice of Randy McStine. Produced by the renowned Mark Plati, known for his work with legends like David Bowie and Prince, this song blends rock and synth sounds to create a stirring track that transforms personal struggles into a message of freedom. “My Sanity” sets a moody yet energetic tone, with vibrant synths and driving guitars creating a backdrop for McStine’s emotionally charged vocals. He’s well regarded for his past work with Porcupine Tree and his solo projects, and in this track, he expresses the deep pain of being misled and the joy of finally breaking free. The song builds like a personal battle, fighting against self-doubt and taking back control. https://open.spotify.com/album/6GawwCsn8w2GQUrGlfm0E7?si=rmQKBVjPRL-2PHe7je_dDw The production by Plati is polished and cinematic, enhancing the song’s emotional depth while still keeping a lively rock energy. Each musical layer adds to the tension and release, reflecting the journey of overcoming a toxic relationship. “My Sanity” is a song for anyone who has struggled to find their truth. With Rooftop Screamers’ excellent songwriting, McStine’s passionate performance, and Plati’s expert touch, this track deserves to be played loud and enjoyed repeatedly. Follow on: Facebook
